###### November 6, 2026


**Parsippany, NJ – November 6, 2026** – CorMedix Therapeutics (Nasdaq: CRMD) today announced that it will report its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, before the market opens on Thursday, November 12, 2026, and will host a corporate update conference call at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Standard Time.


***Thursday, November 12th at 8:30 a.m. EST*** Domestic: 1-844-676-2922
International: 1-412-634-6840
Webcast:[Webcast Link](https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=jEvPktYr)
****


**About CorMedix**


CorMedix Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing therapeutic products for the prevention and treatment of life-threatening conditions and diseases in the United States. CorMedix is focused on selling and marketing products in institutional settings of care in the US and has field-based medical and commercial infrastructure deployed in hospitals, clinics and infusion centers. For more information visit:[www.cormedix.com](http://www.cormedix.com/) . ****
